notes: The verse writes both arms of rule 20: tei adelphei has no pronoun beside it and takes our on the article, while toi systratiotei has hemon and is emptied. Confirmed on review.
The two anarthrous datives Apphia and Archippus keep their own supplied to under rule 21's determinerless clause, while the articular tei ekklesiai gives to the to the article headed on the.

tei ... ekklesiai is an attributive article across an interposed prepositional phrase (rule 57); the ASV supplies no relative clause, so rule 31's carve-out does not arise and the article simply takes the.
